basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/QCryptonPQCScanner/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. Post-quantum cryptography readiness for Microsoft Sentinel. Ingests findings on quantum-vulnerable Key Vault keys, classical-signed TLS certificates, App Service/Storage TLS posture, and CMK provenance via the Codeless Connector Framework (RestApiPoller). Ships with 1 data connector, 5 analytic rules, workbook, and Teams-notification playbook. **Data Connectors:** 1, **Workbooks:** 1, **Analytic Rules:** 5, **Playbooks:** 1 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This solution installs workbook(s) to help you gain insights into the telemetry collected in Microsoft Sentinel. After installing the solution, start using the workbook in Manage solution view.
This solution installs the following analytic rule templates. After installing the solution, create and enable analytic rules in Manage solution view.

An Azure App Service is configured to accept inbound TLS below 1.3. Only TLS 1.3 supports
the negotiation of hybrid PQ key exchange (X25519MLKEM768 etc.); legacy versions cannot be
upgraded to PQ without a client protocol change.

elements.name: analytic2
elements.label: Certificate expiring after 2030 still uses classical signature

options.text:
A TLS or Key Vault certificate has an expiry date after 2030-01-01 and is signed with a
quantum-vulnerable classical algorithm. Long-lived certificates are the primary harvest-now-
decrypt-later risk vector. Reissue with a PQ-hybrid signature or shorten validity window.

A resource with quantum-vulnerable posture appeared that was not observed in the previous
24-hour scan cycle. Investigate whether this is a new deployment that should have been
provisioned with PQ-hybrid cryptography from the start.

elements.name: analytic4
elements.label: Quantum-vulnerable key detected in Key Vault

options.text:
A key in Azure Key Vault has been classified as quantum-vulnerable (RSA or elliptic-curve).
These key types are broken by Shor's algorithm on a sufficiently large fault-tolerant quantum computer.
Rotate to a PQ-hybrid key (ML-KEM, ML-DSA) or plan migration before the harvest-now-decrypt-later
window closes for long-lived data.

elements.name: analytic5
elements.label: Public TLS certificate with classical signature on Application Gateway

options.text:
An Application Gateway or Front Door is presenting a TLS certificate signed with a classical
algorithm (RSA / ECDSA) that is quantum-vulnerable. If the certificate's validity extends past
the plausible arrival of cryptographically-relevant quantum computers, replace with a PQ-hybrid
certificate now.

This solution installs the Playbook templates to help implement your Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) operations. After installing the solution, these will be deployed under Playbook Templates in the Automation blade in Microsoft Sentinel. They can be configured and managed from the Manage solution view in Content Hub.
